instruments.name: Public Record Validator
instruments.purpose: Enforce public record, dossier, release, and archive invariants.
instruments.input_contract: Versioned public HMS JSON records and repository indexes.
instruments.output_contract: Deterministic pass/fail diagnostics and a validated-object count.
instruments.offline_behavior: Runs entirely on local repository files.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Reads only paths explicitly present in the checked-out public repository.
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: Not qualified as a standalone ordinary-user application; released as developer source.
limitations: Conformance does not prove a research claim true.
Requires a supported Python environment.
instruments.release_gate: Released within the approved v0.1.0 public foundation.

instruments.name: LP Source Audit Inventory
instruments.purpose: Hash and classify private intake while keeping raw workstation metadata private.
instruments.output_contract: Deterministic local inventory and sanitized aggregate report.
instruments.offline_behavior: Runs entirely against a selected local tree.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Raw paths and potentially sensitive metadata remain local unless explicitly promoted.
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: Not qualified as a standalone ordinary-user application; released as developer source.
limitations: Inventory counts are not correctness claims.
Archives may contain formats the scanner cannot inspect.
instruments.release_gate: Released within the approved v0.1.0 public foundation.

instruments.name: HMS Expedition Verifier
instruments.purpose: Verify sealed public Expedition submissions without disclosing protected answer material.
instruments.input_contract: Expedition ID, client version, and explicit submission sent only to the configured official HTTPS verifier.
instruments.output_contract: Signed HMS_EXPEDITION_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_V2 with PASS/FAIL, submission hash, service authority, and no submitted plaintext.
instruments.offline_behavior: Public instructions and synthetic self-tests work offline; protected answer verification requires the official service.
instruments.network_behavior: One explicit HTTPS verification request is required; production also requires edge rate limiting, TLS, and request-body log suppression.
instruments.privacy_behavior: No answer predicate ships publicly. The service receives the submitted answer transiently and must not log request bodies; receipts retain only its SHA-256.
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: Automated source and unconfigured Windows-package qualification pass; exact deployed-service and configured-client human UAT has not begun.
limitations: The service cannot prevent participants from sharing an answer.
Rate limiting reduces official-oracle abuse but does not promise absolute secrecy.
Current public campaign is closed.
instruments.release_gate: Deploy and audit the exact service, configure the exact client, pass abuse/privacy/accepted/rejected and clean-environment UAT, then approve both subjects.

instruments.name: Corpus Manifest Verifier
instruments.purpose: Determine whether a selected folder exactly matches a declared corpus manifest.
instruments.input_contract: Researcher-selected folder, versioned manifest, and explicit strictness mode.
instruments.output_contract: HMS_CORPUS_VERIFICATION_V1 report with PASS/MISMATCH and expected, verified, missing, altered, and undeclared entries.
capabilities: fit zoom pan and page navigation
instruments.offline_behavior: Runs entirely on explicit local inputs.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Does not crawl outside the selected root and does not include the local root path in the portable report.
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: The prior rc.3 remains an immutable qualified subject. The nautical 0.2 visual-viewer revision requires a new build, package qualification, and human UAT.
limitations: A manifest match does not prove historical authenticity.
The user supplies page images locally; the application does not redistribute the corpus.
Canonical experiments may block mismatch while explicit user-corpus experiments remain permissible and recorded.
instruments.release_gate: Build and qualify a new immutable 0.2 release candidate, then complete clean-environment human UAT and exact-checksum approval.

instruments.name: Public GP29 Calculator
instruments.purpose: Evaluate Latin, rune, or explicit-token GP29 values with deterministic L/R/prime/N/Q output.
instruments.input_contract: English A-Z characters, deliberate longest-match Latin sounds, canonical runes, or explicit separated tokens under the frozen GP29 table.
instruments.output_contract: Deterministic dashboard, per-rune rows, aggregate L/R/prime/N/Q values, canonical digest, JSON export, and CSV breakdown.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Inputs and exports remain local unless the user explicitly shares them.
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: Owner-approved iterative packaged-app acceptance with the separate-clean-machine limitation recorded; independent GitHub Windows qualification passed.
limitations: GP29 is a calculator, not a solver.
Numerical relationships are not by themselves evidence of a Liber Primus solution.
Compare, batch, target matching, simplification, and solving are outside v0.1.1.

instruments.name: HMS Endeavour Lite
instruments.purpose: Unify bounded public GP29, corpus identity, read-only Atlas, and Expedition entry workflows in one free local-first workstation.
instruments.input_contract: Explicit local HMS project, selected rune token, GP29 text and mode, corpus manifest and private local corpus folder, page selection, research object, bounded declared comparison, or saved Result.
instruments.output_contract: Immutable local Runs, HMS_RESULT_ENVELOPE_V1 Results, HMS_RESEARCH_OBJECT_V1 objects, audits, privacy-safe backups, and explicit exports.
capabilities: embedded 75-page Atlas viewer with zoom and pan
instruments.offline_behavior: Projects, GP29, corpus verification, page viewing, research objects, history, audit, backup, and exports operate locally without an account.
instruments.network_behavior: No active network access. Expedition remains fail-closed until its separately gated HTTPS service is approved and configured.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Private by default; corpus roots remain in local settings, page images are viewed in place and not copied, safe backups strip the local path, and nothing leaves the device without explicit export or future submission action.
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: Source, exact packaged, Atlas viewer, recovery, privacy, and Defender qualification pass; final clean-environment visual UAT and owner approval remain pending.
limitations: In development, not yet a public release.
The user supplies corpus images locally; page images are not distributed in the package.
Advanced annotation, translation, research history, integrations, experiments, and member tooling belong to the separately packaged Runtime Environment.
Expedition is disabled until its secure service/client is approved.
No solver, sockets, accounts, or hosted synchronization are included.
instruments.release_gate: Freeze the bounded Lite surface, remove member-only delivery from its package, rebuild, qualify, and obtain exact-checksum owner approval.

instruments.name: HMS Endeavour Runtime Environment
instruments.purpose: Provide the advanced local Liber Primus visual research environment served by Aegis Trust Core to approved member tiers.
instruments.input_contract: Explicit private local corpus root, selected registered pages, page-scoped regions, rune selections, transcription or translation notes, and a private workspace file.
instruments.output_contract: Private page workspaces with normalized visual regions, rune selections, researcher notes, and no embedded corpus images.
instruments.offline_behavior: The current prototype runs locally and offline.
instruments.network_behavior: No network, authentication, entitlement, synchronization, or hosted integration is implemented in this prototype.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Page images remain in the user-selected local corpus; workspace JSON stores only the local reference and researcher-authored metadata.
test_vectors: private runtime syntax and visual UAT
instruments.ordinary_user_acceptance: Internal visual prototype launched successfully; package qualification and member UAT have not begun.
limitations: Private prototype, not a public GitHub release or current Patreon download.
Researcher translations and marked regions are notes, not verified results.
The local corpus path is private metadata and must be stripped from any shareable export.
No entitlement enforcement, automatic solving, collaboration, or plugin execution exists yet.
instruments.release_gate: Move the complete build into a private versioned repository, add share-safe export and entitlement packaging, test clean Windows builds, and approve each tier delivery by exact checksum.

instruments.name: Advanced GP Laboratory
instruments.purpose: Provide saved GP calculations, comparisons, sequences, batches, simplification, and target exploration.
instruments.input_contract: PLANNED: versioned GP sequences, targets, controls, and bounded parameter families.
instruments.output_contract: PLANNED: complete candidate family with scores, denominator, parameters, controls, and provenance.
instruments.network_behavior: Protected execution, if hosted, must be authorized server-side.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Private by default; no silent upload or publication.
limitations: Not built.
Candidate scores do not establish truth.
instruments.release_gate: Blocked until the public GP29 release and core Runtime experiment contracts are usable.

instruments.name: Hosted Liber Runtime Beta
instruments.purpose: Extend the released local Runtime Environment with hosted experiments, entitlements, contextual assistance, and synchronized research history.
instruments.input_contract: Versioned local job specifications referencing immutable inputs, operations, parameters, visibility, and environment.
instruments.output_contract: Deterministic Run/Result records with job, specification, and result hashes plus operation-scoped evidence labels.
instruments.offline_behavior: Not applicable; the released local workstation remains the offline path.
instruments.network_behavior: Not built. Future connections require authenticated, capability-scoped authorization.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Private by default; source material may never upload without explicit user action and a disclosed retention policy.
limitations: Not built or available.
The local HMS Endeavour Runtime Environment is a separate public workstation candidate.
No authentication, entitlements, quotas, sockets, hosted compute, or contextual AEGIS exists yet.
instruments.release_gate: Begin only after the local Runtime Environment is released and its object lifecycle is stable.

instruments.name: GP Solver
instruments.purpose: Generate bounded GP candidates and parameter families for human evaluation.
instruments.input_contract: PLANNED: declared hypothesis, inputs, bounded search family, controls, budget, metrics, and success gate.
instruments.output_contract: PLANNED: full retained candidate family and scores; never a solve declaration.
instruments.network_behavior: Any hosted compute must enforce server-side entitlement and quota.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Candidate work remains private until explicit evidence promotion.
limitations: Not built.
Returns candidates only and cannot promote evidence.
instruments.release_gate: Blocked until GP29, Experiment Engine, Runtime Beta, Auto Explore, and evidence controls are accepted.

instruments.name: Batch Experiment Engine
instruments.purpose: Execute declared experiment families with budgets, controls, complete retention, and comparable Results.
instruments.input_contract: PLANNED: experiment, immutable inputs, transform family, parameter space, budget, controls, and success gate.
instruments.output_contract: PLANNED: complete family of Runs/Results with failures, scores, denominator, resource use, and provenance.
instruments.network_behavior: Hosted execution must enforce authenticated capabilities, quotas, cancellation, and audit.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Jobs and results remain private by default.
limitations: Not built.
Compute access changes capability, not evidence truth.
instruments.release_gate: Blocked until the Experiment Engine and Runtime Beta object lifecycle are accepted.

instruments.name: Socket/API Integration Layer
instruments.purpose: Expose authenticated, capability-scoped programmatic Runtime operations.
instruments.input_contract: PLANNED: authenticated versioned requests using the same job/result contracts as the UI.
instruments.output_contract: PLANNED: authorized responses, job events, errors, and audit references.
instruments.network_behavior: Every connection and operation must authenticate and authorize server-side.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Least-privilege scopes, revocation, explicit upload, and auditable access are mandatory.
limitations: Not built.
An API does not expand evidence authority.
instruments.release_gate: Blocked until stable Runtime contracts, identity, entitlements, quotas, audit, and recovery exist.

instruments.name: Add-on and Plugin SDK
instruments.purpose: Support versioned, capability-scoped third-party and HMS instrument extensions.
instruments.input_contract: PLANNED: signed/versioned plugin manifest, declared permissions, compatibility, inputs, outputs, and resource needs.
instruments.output_contract: PLANNED: sandboxed instrument results using the shared Result shell and provenance contracts.
instruments.offline_behavior: Offline capability must be declared per plugin.
instruments.network_behavior: No plugin receives network access unless separately declared and approved.
instruments.privacy_behavior: Plugins receive only explicit scoped data access; no Vault access by default.
limitations: Not built.
Plugin output cannot bypass evidence review or authority labels.
instruments.release_gate: Blocked until the integrated Runtime, permission model, sandbox, registry, compatibility policy, and recovery behavior are accepted.
